title: Loss-Tolerant Quantum Position Verification for Metropolitan Area Networks
summary: A spacetime seal, a cryptographic guarantee that a digital event has occurred at an approved location and time, can augment a digital signature with location attestation for legal, financial, and regulatory use cases. In adversarial settings any purely classical realization of such a seal can be spoofed. Quantum position verification (QPV) offers a physics-based solution, exploiting the no-cloning theorem and the no-signaling principle to certify a party's spacetime coordinates.
